title: 第3章 叶开清醒第4章 王琳搅局
content_zh:
王艳听到了叶开的喊声，从屋里出来，站在走廊里，呵斥道：“你小子，乱嚷嚷什么呢？”
叶开依然沉浸在巨大的喜悦中，根本没听见王艳的话，嘴里不停地叫着“我练成一阳指啦！”
王艳扑哧笑了，“真是个傻子，练武练傻了，连武侠小说都信。
你要是能练成一阳指，老娘我还练成九阴白骨爪呢！”
说完，还朝着叶开隔空抓了一下。
“淋吧，你就站在那里叫雨淋吧！”
一阵大风吹来，冷嗖嗖的，王艳打了个寒颤，转身又进屋了。
叶开神智一片清明，最近一年的经历就像过电影一样在脑海里浮现。
刚上大三那年，他练武走火入魔，退学回到家里，父亲恨铁不成钢，急火攻心一病不起，家里只剩下他一个人。
王艳见他身强力壮，让他当小工干活，干了半年，一分钱工资都没发。
村长张有权趁叶开糊涂了，骗他按下指印，霸占了他家三亩地和果园。
叶开握紧了拳头，在心里发狠，
“张有权，你霸占我家的地！”
“王艳，你让老子白干活！”
“你们这对狗男女欠我的，必须加倍还给我！”
叶开身上都被雨淋透了，衬衫和裤子紧紧地贴在身上，浑身的肌肉鼓鼓的。
王艳心里一阵骚动，死死地盯着叶开看。
她不由自主地咽下一口唾沫，好雄壮的小伙子啊！
王艳今年二十四岁，嫁过来三年了。
她是张有权的二房，张有权大老婆死了，又娶了王艳。

张有权今年五十多，由于平时玩得很花，被酒色掏空了身体，根本满足不了正值虎狼之年的王艳。
张有权担心王艳给他戴绿帽子，平时对王艳看得很紧。
今天张有权去县里开会了，家里只剩下王艳、叶开，还有一个帮工叶铁牛。
看见叶开那一身腱子肉，王艳心动了。
这小子长得很帅，那脸蛋跟电影明星似的。
这小子的身材健硕，肌肉发达，耕地的时候就像一头公牛，不知疲倦。
这身体杠杠滴！
要是能跟叶开……
那该多美啊！
虽然叶开是个憨子，但是憨子也有憨子的好处，弄完了不会说出去。
想到这，王艳跑进雨里把叶开拽到堂屋，拿了一条干毛巾给叶开擦去脸上的雨水，心疼地说：
“真是个傻小子，下大雨都不知道躲。”
外面的雨小了些，帮工叶铁牛打着伞走了。
院子里只剩下王艳和叶开两个人。
王艳帮叶开擦干净头上的雨水，又给他擦身上的水。
content_en:
Wang Yan heard Ye Kai's shouting, came out of the house, stood in the corridor, and scolded: "You kid, what are you yelling about?"
Ye Kai was still immersed in great joy and didn't hear Wang Yan's words at all. He kept shouting, "I have mastered Yi Yang Finger!"
Wang Yan chuckled, "What a fool. He has become so stupid by practicing martial arts that he even believes in martial arts novels.
If you can practice Yi Yang Finger, I can also practice Nine Yin White Bone Claw! "
After saying that, he even grabbed Ye Kai from the air.
"Let it rain, just stand there and let it rain!"
A strong wind blew, and it was so cold that Wang Yan shuddered, turned around and entered the house again.
Ye Kai's mind was clear, and the experiences of the past year appeared in his mind like a movie.
In his junior year of college, he became obsessed with martial arts. He dropped out of school and returned home. His father hated iron and steel, and he was so anxious that he couldn't afford it. He was the only one left in the family.
Wang Yan saw that he was strong and strong, so she asked him to work as a laborer. He worked for half a year without paying a penny in wages.
Village head Zhang Quanquan took advantage of Ye Kai's confusion and tricked him into pressing his fingerprints and occupied his family's three acres of land and orchard.
Ye Kai clenched his fists and felt fierce in his heart.
"Zhang Quanquan, you are occupying my land!"
"Wang Yan, you made me work in vain!"
"What you two bastards owe me, you must pay me back twice as much!"
Ye Kai's body was soaked by the rain, his shirt and pants clung tightly to his body, and his muscles were bulging.
Wang Yan felt a commotion in her heart and stared at Ye Kai.
She swallowed involuntarily, what a majestic young man!
Wang Yan is twenty-four years old this year and has been married for three years.
She is Zhang Quanquan's second wife. Zhang Quanquan's eldest wife died and he married Wang Yan.
Zhang Quanquan is over fifty this year. Because he usually plays a lot and is exhausted by drinking and sex, he cannot satisfy Wang Yan who is in the age of tiger and wolf.
Zhang Quanquan was worried that Wang Yan would cuckold him, and he usually kept a close eye on Wang Yan.
Today Zhang Quanquan went to the county for a meeting. Only Wang Yan, Ye Kai and a helper Ye Tieniu were left at home.
Wang Yan's heart was moved when she saw Ye Kai's tendons.
This guy is very handsome, with a face like a movie star.
This boy has a strong body and strong muscles. When plowing the fields, he is like a bull, tireless.
This body is awesome!
If only I could follow Ye Kai...
How beautiful that would be!
Although Ye Kai is a fool, being a fool also has the advantages of being a fool, and he will not tell anyone after he has done it.
Thinking of this, Wang Yan ran into the rain and dragged Ye Kai to the main room, took a dry towel to wipe the rain off Ye Kai's face, and said distressedly:
"What a stupid boy. He doesn't even know how to hide when it rains heavily."
The rain outside became lighter, and the helper Ye Tieniu left with an umbrella.
There were only two people left in the yard, Wang Yan and Ye Kai.
Wang Yan helped Ye Kai wipe the rain off his head and wiped the water on his body.
